data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=T-8m1ka3dp4Q7kNvgHmQQTq&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBLShy91MeDuHF1KxWgH7zTVUGocfsBAxoZV8_AYMHrkA&oe=67600F9C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=iXt6E96Ru70Q7kNvgFRaXpu&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAC3PLPexYU-PI6T2XNX53NQ4RMH4gCCNLWU2xjoKF3EA&oe=67601924)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=DtKIDfxCO6gQ7kNvgFkA9Gb&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBmhX5ViH8nvV3pTvsO1Ou1GyI3ZLmHwrOc0tQ5AcXTHQ&oe=67600087)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=9RuPeyZD-J4Q7kNvgFfIxSo&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAToIN2wK1xh6DjcUa2-DVxe2j5GGEjYuGWdF4n6UzZjA&oe=675FF366)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=tO0HHy4vZcIQ7kNvgGIK5N0&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCNDvYQbgVlAnjCwTiNkhSRnxU6dmnwtv8JP50Oz36xbg&oe=67601FD8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=RxOTpuQLI8wQ7kNvgG4_tHD&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAOlawdmGvs02y2RS-q-SrJEQWDn7rQJtQPfHC_AyWqzA&oe=67601C59)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NNVzyduLvw4Q7kNvgGXcAG8&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB_G56UW32NJO14ajwdV76Imf-wgIaxrcwhq89SzVw4dw&oe=67600270)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=rnoSJ0J2DTEQ7kNvgFLIEMA&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCHaSagQSWD9Psmp-p4F60SwwasDD7b6b5f5zawaFaxHg&oe=6760252A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=bKjUrQbHcdoQ7kNvgGjLEHp&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBHZ7stW6ofRz1_X5GHWxBjH-yAE0ksx82krLGqynkG5Q&oe=67600097)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=54Na70NBwMUQ7kNvgGQCkiM&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA_ZTI5FvkYSL3AJdR8UXwgtIxFb0mAxPi64AWnw5QI7w&oe=67601C0C)
